title: IBM security advisory (AV26-1064)
description: As of October 19, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
IBM Concert
	Prior to or equal to 3.0.0

IBM MQ Advanced container images
	Multiple versions

IBM Sterling Connect Direct for Unix
	Prior to or equal to 6.3.0.7
Prior to or equal to 6.4.0.6
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
